utoHotkey script that:

remembers where the input boxes are in each window (you tap two hotkeys once to “mark” them),

bounces clipboard text back and forth,

pastes and hits Enter,

waits for a reply (configurable),

then swaps directions and repeats—until you stop it.

Below is a production-ready script (AutoHotkey v1) with pause/stop controls, tooltips, and safe"
